name: Warp Splinter
shortDescription: Warp Splinter, represented in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: Named as holder of the Top Shard of the Arcatraz Key in the Botanica. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, formation, or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the original Burning Crusade client/model before human review. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
